svg.text: EventPrime — data model over the WordPress core tables
Records (event / performer / booking) = CPT + postmeta. Only ticket definitions use real custom tables. Venue + organizer = taxonomies.

g.text: WP core · every CPT entity = 1 row (post_type)
WP core · every em_* field + serialized blobs
amber = CPT / taxonomy entity (wp_posts or wp_terms row)
purple dotted = "is one row in wp_posts"
